abstract: AIM: to find out the distribution of germ cell tumor based on age, histopathology, stadium, chemotherapy regimen, and number of cases per year in patients hospitalized in Dharmais National Cancer Hospital during the period of January 2000 to December 2004. METHODS: the data were collected from medical record of patients with testicular carcinoma that were treated on inpatient and outpatient basis in Dharmais National Cancer Hospital during the period of January 2000 to December 2004. The data were collected, recorded and analyzed in descriptive manner and presented in tables of distribution and frequency. RESULTS: there were 44 cases testicular carcinoma being analyzed; 40 cases (90.92%) were germ cell tumor, 42.50% aged 21-30 years old; and the most frequent histological type was seminoma (47.50%). About 39.50% of the patients were admitted in stage II of the disease, and 61.59% were put on BEP regimen. Seminoma type was more frequent in >or= 30-year-old age group while on the other hand, non-seminoma was mostly found in <or= 30-year-old patients. There was a relative increase of germ cell tumor cases from January 2000 to December 2004 in Dharmais National Cancer Hospital. CONCLUSION: germ cell tumors were the most common testicular carcinoma in Dharmais National Cancer Hospital from January 2000 to December 2004. Most of the patients were of 21-30-year-old age group. Seminoma type, particularly germ cell tumor, was more frequent than non-seminoma. Most of the patients were admitted to the hospital in the stage II of the disease and the most common chemotherapy used were BEP regiment. There was an increased number of germ cell tumor cases from January 2000 to December 2004 in Dharmais National Cancer hospital.
abstract_ja:
目的：2000年1月から2004年12月にダルマイス国立癌病院で入院または外来治療を受けた患者について、年齢、病理組織学、病期、化学療法レジメン、年別症例数の観点から胚細胞腫瘍の分布を明らかにすること。
方法：同期間に同病院で治療を受けた精巣癌患者の診療記録からデータを収集・記録し、記述的に解析して分布と頻度の表で示した。
結果：精巣癌44例を解析した。40例(90.92%)が胚細胞腫瘍で、42.50%が21～30歳であった。最も多い組織型はセミノーマ(47.50%)であった。患者の約39.50%が病期IIで入院しており、61.59%が化学療法レジメン(BEP)を受けていた。セミノーマ型は30歳以上の年齢層で多く、非セミノーマは30歳以下の患者に多く見られた。2000年1月から2004年12月にかけて、同病院では胚細胞腫瘍の症例が相対的に増加していた。
結論：胚細胞腫瘍は同期間に同病院で最も多い精巣癌であり、患者の多くは21～30歳であった。セミノーマ型は非セミノーマより多く、患者の多くは病期IIで入院し、最も多く用いられた化学療法レジメンはBEPであった。胚細胞腫瘍の症例数は同期間に増加した。
